The '''night spiders''' are [[monster]]s involved in the Spider Swarm event in [[Wilderness Flash Events]].

They spawn continuously with [[Dungeon spider (Wilderness Flash Events)|dungeon spiders]] and [[Ice spider (Wilderness Flash Events)|ice spiders]], and the players collectively must kill a varying number of them. The number scales with the number of players participating in the event. Each player needs to deal 70K damage for the event to be considered successful.

The life points scales with the number of players participating in the event, determined by the expression <math>8\,000 + 2\,250N</math>, where <math>N</math> is the number of players involved.

They don't have any [[drops]].
